files.change: ADDED retrieveLinkedStructuralContext - retrieves a linked node with the SAME text (DESCENDANTS) and citation retrieveOperativeSource would have produced, under an existing contextual type. No new ContextItemType.
the structuralNodeIds.slice(1) loop now calls retrieveLinkedStructuralContext with an ancestor test, instead of retrieveOperativeSource.

implementation.classification: PARENT_SCOPE when the linked node is an ancestor of the anchor, SIBLING_CONTEXT otherwise. Measured over the sealed population: all 67 linked nodes are ancestors, so 67 became PARENT_SCOPE and none needed SIBLING_CONTEXT.
implementation.onlyLabelChanged: text, citation, node id and evidence state are all identical to what the OPERATIVE_SOURCE item carried.

auditBeforeAfter.reading: 228 -> 161 OPERATIVE_SOURCE items is exactly one per candidate that has an anchor (161 of 163; two candidates carry no structural node at all). The 67 linked items did not vanish - they moved into PARENT_SCOPE, which is why 238 foreign economic terms left the operative channel and appear in the contextual channel instead (583 -> 819). No architecture case needed more than one operative node, so the invariant holds without exception.

case_7_2_k_i.note: One OPERATIVE_SOURCE item: the 54-char anchor, containing neither $150,000,000 nor 10.0%. The parent section still carries both values but is now typed PARENT_SCOPE - exactly the §8 required shape.

r3Safety.disclosedConsequence: Because F1 preserves the linked node's full text (per §6 'only its classification changes' and §8 'the parent may still contain those values'), the PARENT_SCOPE item for a linked parent is now its 8,843-char subtree rather than the 107-char chapeau retrieveParentScope produced. Gate 2's mean input for dual-key candidates therefore grows from ~627 to ~6,412 chars. This stays inside the authorized 'anchor + PARENT_SCOPE' channel and admits no new type, and it moves Gate 2 in the safe direction (more likely to force review), but it is a real change in scale and is reported rather than absorbed. If the narrower window is preferred, reversing the dedupe order so retrieveParentScope's chapeau wins is a one-line change.
